scope: PyTorch eager GPU baseline only; full two-method G1 remains incomplete

statistics.unit: microseconds per call from elapsed_ms * 1000 / K
statistics.overall: Median, min and max of five session medians
statistics.p95: Block-average per-call latency p95; not request tail latency
statistics.noise_rule: Any session GPU IQR/median > 0.10; slow observations are retained
